name: Redueña (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over beige (pale yellow), charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Redueña (a holm oak on white and crosses on white above waves).
history: The arms and flag of Redueña were approved on 12 September 2013, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid on 30 September 2013; the flag is a rectangular cloth of proportions 2:3, divided horizontally, green above and beige or light chestnut below, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Redueña arms — holm oak on white and crosses on white above waves
